subject: The country of origin of an electric scooter
reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedent on two-wheeled vehicles and e-scooters (e.g., N349019 and N344694), CBP holds that the frame imparts the essential character of a scooter or bike. Here, the aluminum frame components (head tube, oblique tube, brackets, etc.) are extruded, CNC-machined, and welded into a complete frame assembly in Vietnam. The subsequent assembly of Chinese-origin components (motor, battery, wheels, electronics) onto the Vietnamese frame in China does not substantially transform the frame. Thus, the country of origin is Vietnam.
